Astraeon_04_ea6d0b63.text: I was the light that taught your sky to [hot]shine[/]. [beat] Now I am only its [shake]ending[/].

Astraeon_07_111cf659.text: Then let me show you [slow]what light does[/] when it is [shake]angry[/].

Astraeon_09_8ea9beaa.text: [glitch]Every star I ever lit -- I take them BACK.[/]

Warden_01_524ee146.text: [whisper]Four hundred winters... and the lock [wave]finally[/] gives.[/]

Warden_02_c6ff6dc7.text: The dark behind the door has [hot]heard you knocking[/].

Warden_03_33571970.text: [slow]I am the Warden.[/] [beat] I was asked to hold one door. [beat] Just [hot]one[/].

Warden_04_af855ee9.text: I will not hate you. [beat] Hatred is for those with [wave]time[/].

Warden_06_19443207.text: You press the lock the way [hot]he[/] did, the last one who came.

Warden_07_64319c5e.text: I buried him [beat] under [shake]that[/] floor. [beat] Mind your footing.

Warden_08_569f0661.text: [big]Do you hear it?[/] [beat] The door is [hot]breathing[/].

Warden_09_87820aab.text: I [shake]cannot[/] let it open. [beat] Forgive me what I do [glitch]to prevent it[/].

Warden_11_18f90008.text: [slow]Tell whoever comes after:[/] [beat] the door was never locked [hot]against us[/]. [beat] It was locked [hot]for us[/].

Warden_13_57ad25b6.text: [wave]The door is shut again.[/] [beat] I am, [slow]as ever[/], [hot]sorry[/].

Warden_14_6414ce9a.text: Rest. [beat] You will need it [beat] for the [glitch]next time[/].

Warden_15_253210e0.text: [shake]You are stalling the dark.[/] [beat] Every minute [hot]costs the world[/].

Warden_26_a1f2774f.text: I have done this [slow]a thousand times[/].

Warden_38_612b804a.text: [shake]A hundred lines of dark. [beat] Pick one.[/]

Warden_51_a1e8145d.text: The edge of the seal. [beat] [hot]Cross it[/] and be cut.

Warden_57_aab78a2a.text: [slow]Step wherever you like.[/] [beat] It opens there.

Warden_64_8010d085.text: Stay. [beat] The seal will [hot]close round you[/].

Warden_66_f5377695.text: [slow]A cell is a kindness[/], compared to the door.

Choir_02_7b16afb6.text: A hundred throats [hot]remember the same note[/].

Choir_03_324dca48.text: [wave]We were a hundred voices.[/] [beat] The sea took [hot]ninety-nine[/].

Choir_04_d4893e25.text: We kept the song. [beat] It is all that [slow]kept us[/].

Choir_05_7f3d8a00.text: Sing with us, little [hot]flame[/]. [beat] Or be [wave]the rest[/].

Choir_07_9e807622.text: The second verse is [shake]louder[/]. [beat] The second verse [hot]hurts[/].

Choir_11_f0d26d01.text: [slow]Thank you for the last note.[/] [beat] We never could [hot]finish it[/].

Choir_20_bc48887d.text: Who taught you to [hot]strike the rest[/]?

Choir_31_f407bbe5.text: [whisper]Do you hear it? [beat] Under the water?[/]

Choir_48_abcfcd5e.text: The first blow is only the [slow]announcement[/].

Regent_03_ff172289.text: [big]BEHOLD THE REGENT[/] of nine burning cities!

Regent_04_e0610c2b.text: I wore a crown of a thousand hearths. [beat] I wear them still, [hot]as ash[/].

Regent_05_26f03c88.text: Kneel, and I may scorch you [slow]gently[/]. [beat] Stand, and I will [shake]make an example[/].

Regent_08_534f8165.text: [big][shake]I AM THE FIRE THAT FORGETS NOTHING![/][/]

Regent_09_37121b5e.text: My court has [hot]fallen[/]. [beat] So the [glitch]hall burns with it[/].

Regent_12_70a15f1f.text: [slow]The throne is yours.[/] [beat] It was never [hot]comfortable[/].

Regent_29_a4ff4fce.text: Is that all [hot]your people[/] could send?

Regent_33_6338be82.text: [wave]Does no one else dare approach the crown?[/]

Regent_52_e16aca81.text: [slow]Where do you think you are going?[/]

Seraph_03_6f0e5e20.text: [slow]I am the Seraph.[/] [beat] The sky keeps a [hot]ledger[/].

Seraph_04_f053ba91.text: Your name was entered at birth. [beat] The sentence was [hot]not[/] revealed.

Seraph_09_6204a120.text: [glitch]No more mercy. No more weather. [beat] Only [hot]verdict[/].[/]

Seraph_32_142cd698.text: [wave]Thunder is only a verdict... [beat] [hot]clearing its throat[/].[/]

Seraph_40_ca3c70bf.text: [glitch]I am the storm that [beat] ENDS storms.[/]

Rime_02_ecd307ee.text: [slow]Something very old is [hot]turning over[/] in its sleep.[/]

Rime_03_2b1555ce.text: [slow]Little warm thing.[/] [beat] You have [hot]come so far[/].

Rime_04_4852741f.text: I have held the [wave]winter[/] for ten thousand years. [beat] It is [slow]so heavy[/].

Rime_05_a3e9c2d8.text: Lie down. [beat] [hot]I will take it from you[/].

Rime_07_aa46fe87.text: Do not be [wave]afraid[/]. [beat] The cold is only [hot]a kind of quiet[/].

Rime_09_5ee43f86.text: [whisper]I am not angry.[/] [beat] [slow]I am only [hot]so tired[/] of the [shake]noise[/].[/]

Rime_13_d181b98b.text: [slow]I will not follow.[/] [beat] [wave]Winter does not need to.[/]

Rime_31_d8bd5348.text: [whisper]Snow is falling in a place you cannot see.[/]

Rime_32_c339b4c7.text: [slow]I can hear your [hot]heartbeat[/].[/] [beat] [wave]It is so loud.[/]

Rime_33_b4ec093d.text: [whisper]Come closer. [beat] I will not bite.[/] [beat] [glitch]I will not.[/]

Rime_47_fbcd87eb.text: [slow]Each one is a [hot]word[/] I could not say.[/]

Knight_04_7dfbecbd.text: I am sworn to [hot]one last duel[/]. [beat] I would [slow]prefer[/] it be a good one.

Knight_05_be66a38b.text: En garde. [beat] [wave]Do try not to disappoint.[/]

Knight_07_b4ec9c30.text: Let us see whether you can [shake]keep up[/].

Knight_12_78f66e10.text: [slow]Take the blade.[/] [beat] [hot]It was always meant for a worthier hand.[/]

Knight_32_7fa88e8c.text: [wave]Do you know how long I have waited for a worthy [hot]opponent[/]?[/]

Knight_33_fe501ed9.text: [whisper]The oath weighs on me. [beat] [slow]Lend me your steel.[/][/]

Astraeon_02_99e7420a.text: [slow]The air [hot]hums[/] with an old, enormous light.[/]

Astraeon_15_956a2c9e.text: [shake]You are a [hot]spark[/]. [beat] Why will you [slow]not go out[/]?[/]

Astraeon_25_708aceb7.text: I have [hot]watched empires[/] smaller than you.

Astraeon_31_7e79a7ef.text: [whisper]Every star you have ever wished upon... [beat] is [hot]me[/].[/]

Astraeon_32_d8115c3b.text: [slow]Do you know [hot]how cold[/] the dark is?[/]

Astraeon_42_9733e77a.text: [shake]One line of light. [beat] Let it find you.[/]
